_comment: Copy the `hooks` block into .claude/settings.json to turn the gate on.
It is NOT wired up in this repo by default: dropping it into
.claude/settings.json would gate every Bash command for anyone who checks
the repo out, which is not a thing to switch on for someone else.
`timeout` is the hook contract's own ceiling in seconds and is the outer
bound; --timeout is the gate's own budget in milliseconds and is what
normally fires. Keep the outer one comfortably larger.
Add --allow-safe only if you want the gate to be able to APPROVE commands.
Without it the gate only ever narrows (ask/deny) and defers otherwise, so
your own permission rules still decide everything it stays quiet about.
